messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Heartburn can mimic early symptoms of a heart attack. Get emergency medical help if you have chest pain that spreads to your jaw or shoulder and you feel sweaty or light-headed.
You should not use omeprazole if you are allergic to it, or if:
- you are also allergic to medicines like omeprazole, such as esomeprazole, lansoprazole, pantoprazole, rabeprazole, Nexium, Prevacid, Protonix, and others;
- you had breathing problems, kidney problems, or a severe allergic reaction after taking omeprazole in the past; or
- you also take HIV medication that contains rilpivirine (such as Complera, Edurant, Odefsey, Juluca).
Ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe to use if you have:
- trouble or pain with swallowing;
- bloody or black stools, vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds;
- heartburn that has lasted for over 3 months;
- frequent chest pain, heartburn with wheezing;
- unexplained weight loss;
- nausea or vomiting, stomach pain;
- liver disease;
- low levels of magnesium, calcium, or potassium in your blood; or
- osteoporosis or low bone mineral density (osteopenia).
Triples: [["Omeprazole", "mimics symptoms of", "heart attack"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to omeprazole"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to esomeprazole"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to lansoprazole"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to pantoprazole"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to rabeprazole"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to Nexium"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to Prevacid"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "allergy to Protonix"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "past breathing problems after use"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "past kidney problems after use"], ["Omeprazole", "contraindicated in", "past severe allergic reaction after use"], ["Omeprazole", "interacts with", "HIV medication containing rilpivirine"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "use with swallowing difficulty or pain"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "bloody or black stools"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "vomit that looks like blood or coffee grounds"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "heartburn lasting over 3 months"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "frequent chest pain"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "heartburn with wheezing"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "unexplained weight loss"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "nausea or vomiting"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "stomach pain"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "liver disease"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "low blood magnesium levels"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "low blood calcium levels"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "low blood potassium levels"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "osteoporosis"], ["Omeprazole", "has warning", "low bone mineral density"], ["Omeprazole", "requires medical evaluation if", "chest pain spreading to jaw or shoulder"], ["Omeprazole", "requires medical evaluation if", "feeling sweaty or light-headed"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has warning", "interacts with", "mimics symptoms of", "requires medical evaluation if"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or allergy specified by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug requires caution or medical evaluation in patients who have the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.  
interacts with: The subject drug may have a pharmacological interaction with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.  
mimics symptoms of: The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.  
requires medical evaluation if: Patients taking the subject drug should seek medical advice if they experience the symptom or condition specified by the object entity.
